EC1: Has bilateral sacroiliitis [OR] Grade 2 or unilateral sacroiliitis Grade 3 [OR] or Grade 4
EC2: Is a nursing [OR] or pregnant female, or intends to become pregnant within 6 months after receiving trial medication
EC3: Intends to donate [AND] eggs [AND] (female [OR] participants) or sperm (male participants) while receiving trial medication [OR] or within 6 months after trial medication
EC4: Has any clinically significant condition or situation that would interfere with the trial evaluations or participation in the trial
EC5: Has ever received any cytotoxic drugs, including chlorambucil [OR], cyclophosphamide [OR], nitrogen mustard [OR], or other alkylating agents
EC6: • Disease-modifying anti-rheumatic drugs (30 days off drug)
EC8: • Investigational medications (30 days [OR] or 5 half-lives off drug, whichever is longer)
EC9: • Bacille Calmette-Guerin (BCG) vaccination (12 months off drug)
EC10: Has any systemic inflammatory condition, including psoriatic arthritis [OR], active Lyme disease [OR], systemic lupus erythematosus [OR], infectious arthritis [OR], vasculitis [OR], parvovirus infection [OR], rheumatoid arthritis [OR], active uveitis [OR], or active IBD
EC11: Has a history of latent [OR] or active granulomatous infection prior to Screening
EC12: Had a nontuberculous mycobacterial infection [OR] or opportunistic infection within 6 months prior to Screening
EC13: Has a history of an infected [OR] joint prosthesis, or has received antibiotics [AND] for a suspected infection [AND] of a joint prosthesis, if that prosthesis has not been removed or replaced
EC14: Had a serious infection [OR], has been hospitalized [OR] for an infection, or has been treated with IV antibiotics [AND] for an infection within 2 months prior to Baseline
EC15: Had a history [OR] of, or ongoing, chronic [OR] or recurrent infectious disease
EC16: Is known to be infected with human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) [OR] or seropositive for hepatitis C virus (HCV)
EC17: Has had a chest x-ray [AND] within 2 months prior to Screening that shows an abnormality suggestive of a current active infection [OR] or malignancy
EC18: Has a history of lymphoproliferative disease
EC19: Has had a malignancy within 5 years before screening ([NOT] exceptions are squamous [OR] and basal cell carcinomas of the skin [OR] and carcinoma in situ of cervix that has been surgically cured)
EC20: Has a history of known demyelinating diseases such as multiple sclerosis [OR] or optic neuritis
EC21: Has a history [OR] of or concurrent congestive heart failure of any grade
EC22: Has a transplanted organ [AND] (with the [NOT] exception of a corneal transplant performed >= 3 months prior to baseline)
EC23: Has current signs or symptoms of significant medical illness which could interfere with the trial [OR], or require treatment that might interfere with the trial
EC24: Is a user of recreational or illicit drugs or has or had a substance abuse (drug or alcohol) problem within the previous 2 years
